scope: Roadmap extraction and execution guidance; no application execution
notes: The stage dependency skeleton is proposed; producer/consumer contracts refine package dependencies.
RW01-01 discovery can start independently; its final inventory must align with RW00-01 before RW02-03 closes.
RW00-05 database subwork can start after RW00-03; package closure also requires RW00-02.
Missing required external approvals continue blocking their release scopes; this plan cannot waive them.
Status proposed denotes future work, not a transition in the eventual live register.
